title: Boot consent launch has no result-backed VPN continuation
reproduction: Pending main-owned live gate: missing real VPN consent with boot enabled; receive boot; tap notification; then use actual Home Resume switch and exercise grant/deny/Back/recreation. Also repeat with alerts denied or VPN channel blocked.
expected: Boot requests only a permitted user-tappable Home reminder; no background consent Activity or automatic activation; actual Home Resume owns the ActivityResult consent flow; prepared/off/ROOT branches unchanged.
observed: Baseline receiver launched system consent directly and had no Activity result owner. Current source requests notification through injected gateway and returns. This lane did not execute Android or consent flows.
fix: Added requestPermissionNotification to the existing gateway; permission/channel-aware helper uses existing VPN resume notification ID and explicit immutable Home intent with no activation extras; two narrow strings. No Home/VPN/manifest edits.
test_evidence: Eight host source contracts passed after four expected pre-fix failures; isolated API36/Android-Java-image type-check passed for changed production/tests with temporary resource bindings; XML and scoped diff checks pass. Five boot and nine notification Android cases not executed; real consent is not replaced by fake gateway proof.

title: Notification expectations ignore blocked channel state retained across recreation
reproduction: Pending main-owned gate: run tests with app permission already enabled and customized/blocked production channels; run disposable NONE versus LOW channel probes with visible positive control and same-ID recreate; separately use preconfigured app-denied fixture.
expected: Tests honor app and channel state without overwriting user settings; independent channel-only suppression is demonstrated only with app permission enabled; production foreground service must be destroyed before its channel is deleted.
observed: Baseline tested only app-wide enablement and assumed delete/recreate reset importance. Current tests preserve snapshots and consult relevant channel state; negative assertions wait through an interval; blocked-channel test uses fresh isolated channels and explicit permission assumption.
fix: Removed routine production-channel deletion; compare preserved settings; await cancellation; test actual NONE-channel suppression of update and boot payloads alongside a visible control; retain stop-before-delete live regression and restoration; no app-wide permission mutation.
test_evidence: Eight host source contracts pass and all nine notification cases pass isolated Android-API type-check; no instrumentation execution. Channel-only case skips if app alerts disabled rather than manufacturing a pass. Main owns actual channel/device replay and integrated resource/build checks.
